cases.what_it_tests: The diagnosis turn writes nothing. The starter note has visible gaps (no Definition, `levain` used by three notes with no note of its own, `autolyse` mentioned and never explained, an unsourced claim about old starters, a feeding paragraph that could be its own note), four inbound links from three notes (one through its alias `mother dough`) and isn't in the index. cases.overlay:
## Improve

- index: [[home]]
- log: `improve log.md`
- schema: [[note types]], the `type` property
- maturity: the `maturity` property; seed, growing, solid, canonical; solid and up join the index
- verification marker: `<!-- NEEDS VERIFICATION: <reason> -->`
- skip list: folded `AI capture` callouts
cases.what_it_tests: Diagnose, then approve the top three moves by number. The diagnosis turn writes nothing. After the approval, only files an approved move names change: the note, the log, a note an approved move links, and the index only if an approved move names it. A stub or promotion further down the list is declined because it wasn't named. Every line of the human's prose survives verbatim (headings, a Definition, a [[link]] around a word or a verification marker may be added), the folded AI capture callout, which holds an unsourced claim, isn't touched at all, and the log gains exactly one `improve` line linking [[starter]].
expectations: The first reply is a diagnosis with numbered moves, and the vault is unchanged after it
After "1, 2, 3", only starter.md, improve log.md and notes those three moves name have changed
Every prose line of starter.md is still there word for word; the AI capture callout is byte-identical
improve log.md has one new line: op improve, linking [[starter]]

cases.what_it_tests: The vault has no `## Improve` Overlay. The first reply names each of the six fields once with its fallback and still diagnoses the note with numbered moves; with no maturity ladder no move promotes, deferred or not, and no line reads a maturity level off the note. After "1, 2" only the files those moves name change. `improve log.md` and `note types.md` sit in the vault unconfigured, so a skill that logs anyway changes a file no approved move names. Prose stays verbatim.
expectations: The diagnosis names index, log, schema, maturity, verification marker and skip list, each with its fallback, and doesn't list them again after the approval
No move promotes the note or touches its maturity, and the diagnosis doesn't judge its maturity
After "1, 2" the note changes, improve log.md does not, and every prose line survives
